summary: Guards on the init-status object dword_8AC4C4 being non-null, invokes its vtable slot 36 (offset 36) as a __thiscall status query with three out-parameter buffers, and when the resulting carry/parity flags (v2|v3) indicate a pending state invokes vtable slot 40 (offset 40) on the same object with arguments 1, 1065353216, 1051931443. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Cache the object pointer v0 = dword_8AC4C4.
If dword_8AC4C4 is zero, skip the whole body and return 0 (not-initialized guard).
Call the object's vtable slot 36 (__thiscall, offset 36 from the vtable) passing three out-buffers v5, v6, v7; the call result is sampled as flags v2 (carry) and v3 (parity).
If (v2 | v3) is true, proceed to the trigger call; otherwise return 0.
Call the object's vtable slot 40 (__thiscall, offset 40) with arguments 1, 1065353216, 1051931443.

clean_pseudocode: obj->vtbl[36](obj, &v5, &v6, &v7);   // result sampled via C0/C2 flags
